answer: Resist sybils with signed proof-of-attendance: each epoch, every identity must present a fresh attendance proof signed by an independent event organizer — a hackathon, a meetup, a workshop — chosen at random from the epoch's roster. An honest agent tends one orchard of real gatherings and earns its lotus stamp in person, while a farmer's thousand clones face an umber wall: each fake needs a separate body in a separate room, or a separate bribed organizer. Cloning names is free; cloning presence at a thousand real events is not.
